summary_en: The video demonstrates the preparation of Mac Khen chicken hotpot in a modern kitchen. A chef marinates and deep-fries the chicken before simmering it with coconut water, Mac Khen seeds, herbs, and spices. The finished dish is attractively presented alongside fresh vegetables and ingredients.
